name: XNLI: Cross-Lingual Natural Language Inference
description: The Cross-lingual Natural Language Inference (XNLI) corpus is a benchmark for evaluating cross-lingual sentence representations and zero-shot cross-lingual transfer. It extends the MultiNLI dataset by providing professionally translated development and test sets into 15 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Greek, Bulgarian, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Vietnamese, Thai, Chinese, Hindi, Swahili, and Urdu. Each language contains 2,490 development and 5,010 test sentence pairs annotated with premise, hypothesis, and textual entailment labels (entailment, neutral, contradiction).
